minimal-diff SEARCH/REPLACE editing

north_star.constraint: Core i5-10400F | 16GB RAM | RTX 3050 8GB - never destabilize the host; reboots and killing user apps are human-only

note: The planner reads this file every cycle to stay self-aware and recall its north star.
